name: Quantize
note: adv_api/quantization general Quantize (distinct from AscendQuant). Quantize<config,DstT,SrcT,ScaleT,OffsetT>(dst,src,scale,offset,QuantizeParams{m,n,groupSize}); config=QuantizeConfig{policy,hasOffset,roundMode,kDim} non-type template param; supports PER_TENSOR/PER_CHANNEL/PER_TOKEN/PER_GROUP. Per-tensor: dst=round(src*scale+offset), scalar scale/offset, no tmp buffer.
